in_sanskrit.name: कामेश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The god who embodies desire and pleasure, often identified with Kamadeva, the Hindu god of love.

in_hindi.name: कामेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: The lord of desire or Kama, the Hindu god of love.

in_tamil.name: காமேஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The lord who embodies desire or Kama, the Hindu god of love.

in_telugu.name: కామేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The lord of desire or Kama, the Hindu god of love.

in_marathi.name: Kamesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kamesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kamesh is the Hindu god of wealth, prosperity, and desire. He is depicted as having four hands, each holding a symbol of abundance: a bowl of gold coins, a lotus, a rosary, and a goad.

in_bengali.name: Kamesh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Wealth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kamesh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Kamesh is the Hindu god of wealth, prosperity, and desire. He is depicted as having four hands, each holding a symbol of abundance: a bowl of gold coins, a lotus, a rosary, and a goad.
